name: It's Raw Poke Truck
notes: 1 photo, a clear 'Main Grinds' menu board with 8 poke bowl items, all legible.

dishes.name: Kimchi Ahi
dishes.description: Garlic based flavor, with hints of spice and the traditional vinegar flavor. Not your usual Korean Kimchi.

dishes.name: Spicy Ahi
dishes.description: Mayo based sauce with masago (fish egg) and sriracha and other spices. The heat level is moderate with it picking up as you indulge on.

dishes.name: Shoyu Ahi
dishes.description: Our most traditional poke. Served with a shoyu sauce containing soy sauce, ginger, inamona (contains nuts).

dishes.name: Wasabi Ahi
dishes.description: Wasabi oil and oyster sauce with a dash sauce. Wasabi heat is mild with a sweet finish.

dishes.name: Furikake Salmon
dishes.description: Sweet and spicy soy glaze with furikake (roasted seaweed, sesame seeds, sugar, salt)

dishes.name: Spicy Salmon
dishes.description: Mayo based sauce with masago (fish eggs) and sriracha mixed with other spices. The heat level is moderate and fuses well with the sweetness of the salmon. Heat n sweet.

dishes.name: Sesame Tako
dishes.description: Hawaiian salt, inamoma, with sesame oil. Plain and simple, light flavor.

dishes.name: Kimchi Shrimp
dishes.description: Garlic based flavor, low on the spice and traditional vinegar flavor. Not your usual Korean Kimchi.
